# First, let's move cursor back to position 0 and test UP on both rows
# Current cursor is at col 22 (position 1), let's go LEFT to position 0
action(['LEFT'])

# Record current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

def get_bottom_hashes(seg_nodes):
    blacks = []
    for n in seg_nodes:
        if n['color'] == 'B':
            min_row = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
            if 40 <= min_row <= 57:
                min_col = min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
                blacks.append((min_row, min_col, n['hash'], n['pixels']))
    blacks.sort()
    return blacks

current_hashes = get_bottom_hashes(nodes)
print("Current hashes (row, col, hash, pixels):")
for h in current_hashes:
    print(f"  {h}")

# Try UP 3 times to see the cycle
for i in range(3):
    action(['UP'])
    new_hashes = get_bottom_hashes(current_frame.segmentation['nodes'])
    print(f"\nAfter UP #{i+1}:")
    for j, (old, new) in enumerate(zip(current_hashes, new_hashes)):
        if old[2] != new[2]:
            row = "blue" if old[0] < 50 else "pink"
            print(f"  {row} symbol at col {old[1]}: {old[2]} -> {new[2]} (pixels {old[3]}->{new[3]})")
    current_hashes = new_hashes
